author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕುಕ್ಕಿ ತಿನ್ನುವರೆಲ್ಲ ತಪ್ಪು ಕಂಡರೆ ನಿನ್ನ
ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದೊಡೆ ಅಣಕಿಸುತ ಮೂಗು ಮುರಿಯುವರು
ಸೊಕ್ಕಿರದೆ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು ಕಂಡೊಡನೆ ತಿದ್ದಿನಡೆ
ದಕ್ಕಿಸಿಕೊ ಜೀವನವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Everyone pecks at you when they see your mistakes;
when they catch you, they mock and turn up their noses;
without arrogance, correct your mistakes as soon as you see them,
and make life your own, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: People pounce on our mistakes. Without pride or defensiveness, correct them as soon as we see them, and life becomes truly ours.
